description: This file contains source code for a module that handles code transformation, including Babel transpilation, source map support, and module resolution logic within the Playwright project. It manages configuration, caching, and hooks for transforming TypeScript and JavaScript files, with specific handling for MD files and integration with source maps.

methods.name: setTransformConfig
methods.description: Sets the Babel plugin configuration and external file matcher based on provided transform configuration.

methods.name: setSingleTSConfig
methods.description: Sets the path to a single TypeScript configuration file.

methods.name: singleTSConfig
methods.description: Returns the path to the current single TypeScript configuration file.

methods.name: transformHook
methods.description: Transforms code using Babel and other preprocessors, with caching and source map support.

methods.name: requireOrImport
methods.description: Dynamically requires or imports a module, with source map support and dependency collection.

methods.name: wrapFunctionWithLocation
methods.description: Wraps a function to provide location information from the call stack for debugging.
